# DeepSeek Harness
English | 中文
DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) is an open-source agent harness developed by DeepSeek AI.
It is built on an **everything-is-a-plugin** architecture and powered by Cordis, whose design is des
cribed in _A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability_.

## Community and support

ugin repository for discoverability.

## Session Doctor community plugin
The community Session Doctor integration helps operators explain why an agent Session stopped, loope
d, retried, or produced an incomplete JSONL log.
- Deterministic diagnosis replays persisted Session events and identifies repeated failed tool calls
, unchanged failure cycles, tool-error bursts, provider retry storms, token-ceiling turns, sustained

context growth, and interrupted turns.
- The Web UI displays findings and can request structured LL

M RCA from bounded, payload-free summaries.
- Cross-Session clustering groups recurring detector, ca

tegory, and recommendation identities so repeated incidents are easier to prioritize.
- Explicit phy
sical repair recovers only a final torn JSONL tail while preserving the valid logical event prefix.
Diagnosis and clustering are read-only. RCA excludes raw messages, tool arguments, call ids, and opa
que metadata; physical repair requires an explicit `--repair` action.
